name: OrderStock by TulipWork
author: Ziyad Bachalany

sections.description:
OrderStock offers a clear, easy way to handle your stock and orders smoothly. Perfect for a busy restaurant, a shop, or any business wanting dependable stock management, this plugin helps you stay on top and saves you time. 🌈

Free Features – Get Started Today! 🎉

  • Effortless Stock Updates: Adjust stock levels on the fly with a sleek, mobile-ready interface—perfect for busy days.
  • Smart Order Suggestions: Let OrderStock crunch the numbers! Choose between Forecast Mode (daily sales × replenishment period) or Threshold Mode (critical threshold & target stock) to get tailored order quantities with a Trend Score twist, capped by maximum limits.
  • One-Click Orders: Generate professional PDF order forms and email suppliers directly from your WordPress dashboard. 📧
  • Supplier Simplicity: Link products to suppliers and filter them effortlessly for quick management.
  • WhatsApp Ordering: Send orders directly to suppliers via WhatsApp with a single click. 📲

Ideal for restaurants, retailers, caterers—or anyone who craves simplicity with power. Crafted by Tulipe Media to fuel your success.

Pro Features – Level Up Your Workflow! ✨

Supercharge your business with a premium license from tulipemedia.com:
– Import/Export Made Easy: Seamlessly transfer product data with CSV files—perfect for bulk updates.
– Order History & Reception: Track every order, update received quantities, log actual costs, and tweak statuses with ease.
– Bulk Editing Power: Save hours by assigning multiple suppliers, tax rates, or stores to products in one go.
– Multiple Suppliers: Flexibility at its finest—assign several suppliers per product for smarter sourcing.
– Multi-Store Mastery: Run multiple locations? Manage them all from one dashboard with centralized stock tracking.
– Central Kitchen Magic: Streamline orders to a main warehouse or kitchen for efficient production.
– Order Consolidation: Combine orders into a single prep list—ideal for kitchens or warehouses.
– Team Permissions: Add users with custom roles (stock editors, order managers, etc.) to delegate tasks securely.
– Inventory Snapshots: Capture stock at any moment for accounting or audits with detailed PDF/CSV exports.
– Insightful Reports: Dive into advanced analytics and real-time cost tracking to optimize your operations.

Explore Pro Features & Docs – Transform how you manage stock!

Why Choose OrderStock? 🌟

  • Lightweight & Fast: No bloat—just the tools you need, running smoothly on any device.
  • User-Friendly: Designed with real merchants in mind—no tech degree required!
  • Community-Driven: Join users worldwide who trust OrderStock to keep their businesses humming.

Contribute

  • 🌐 Translate: Help make the plugin accessible worldwide! Contribute translations at WordPress Translate. Every word counts!
  • Donate: Support ongoing development with a coffee! ☕ Donate now.
  • Rate Me: Love the plugin? Share a 5-star review on WordPress.org to help others discover it.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the orderstock folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘OrderStock’ menu in your admin dashboard to get started.
  4. Add suppliers (Suppliers post type) and products (Products post type) to begin managing your stock.
sections.faq:
How does OrderStock calculate order suggestions?

Choose your style:
– Forecast Mode: Multiplies daily sales by replenishment periods, adjusts with a Trend Score, and respects max quantities.
– Threshold Mode: Suggests orders when stock dips below a critical threshold, aiming for a target level—Trend Score adjustable.
Both modes make ordering a breeze! 🌬️

Can I manage stock from my phone?

Absolutely! OrderStock’s responsive design shines on mobile, letting you update stock or place orders anywhere, anytime.

Can I customize quantity precision?

Yes! In both Free and Pro, set decimal precision (0-3) for each product to match your stock needs—great for items sold by weight or volume. 🎯

What happens if I disable or uninstall OrderStock?

No worries! Disabling OrderStock just pauses it—your products, suppliers, and orders stay safe in WordPress, ready when you are. Uninstalling removes the plugin, but your data hangs on unless you turn on the “Delete Data on Uninstall” option in settings (available in both Free and Pro). You’re always in charge! 😊

How does multi-store work in Pro?

OrderStock Pro lets you assign products to specific stores, track stock per location, and filter orders or inventories by store. It’s your control hub for multiple outlets! 🏪

Can I generate reports without Pro?

Free gives you basic stock tracking, but Pro unlocks powerful reports with insights by period, supplier, store, and category—plus real-time cost tracking. 📊

How can I manage a team with OrderStock?

With Pro, add users with custom roles (e.g., stock editors, order managers) to delegate tasks securely while you stay in charge. Teamwork made simple! 🤝
sections.changelog:
1.3

  • Added: New button to send supplier orders directly via WhatsApp for quick communication.
  • Added: Option to download supplier orders as PDF for easy sharing and record-keeping.
  • Improved: Enhanced “Delete Data on Uninstall” feature for better clarity and reliability.
  • Added: New “Delete All Data Immediately” option for instant data removal when needed.
  • Fixed: Resolved supplier-related bug to ensure accurate order processing.

1.2

  • Added compatibility with WordPress 6.8.
  • Added a support tab for easier user assistance.
  • Improved uninstall process by cleaning up roles.

1.1

  • Added: Ability to assign multiple suppliers to a single product.
  • Added: New calculation mode based on critical threshold and target order quantity.
  • Fixed: Minor bug fixes and performance optimizations.

1.0

  • Initial release: Simple, powerful stock and order management with pagination in Order History.

screenshots.caption: Mobile View: Manage your stock and orders seamlessly on the go with a fully responsive, user-friendly design.
Stock Management: Update stock levels with a clear, category-filtered view—all in one place.
Place an Order: Preview and send orders with supplier-specific totals and PDFs.
Order Warnings: Preview critical alerts before ordering, like "Do not include prices in the generated order," "Force order despite Threshold," or "The following suppliers have no email address."
Product Editing: Fine-tune product details with precision—set stock levels, supplier info, pricing, tax rates, and packaging, all from a single, intuitive interface.
Settings Page: Configure your stock and order preferences—set admin emails, tax rates, order modes, and more from a simple interface.
Generated Order PDF: View the professional PDF order form received via email, complete with supplier details and totals.
